d: If you are doing cardio to lose fat, there is a good chance you are making the worst cardio mistakes everyone makes for fat loss without even knowing it. In this video, I am going to show you why the treadmill, elliptical, StairMaster, bike, and even your fitness tracker may be lying to you about how many calories you burned. If you use those numbers to decide how much more you can eat, you could be wiping out your calorie deficit.
